_about: Pay thresholds: the ONE place these numbers live. Scripts read them through common.pay_rules(). Sample values: replace with your own. Base pay only (OTE never counts). Change a number here and nowhere else.
_screen_min: Hard screen (sweeps, screen_leads.py): a stated base top, or a no-pay title's market base top, under this = fail.
_vet_floor: Vetting floor (verdict, triage, salary_gap.py): a base top at or above this clears. Between screen_min and vet_floor = flag as the user's call, never an auto-skip.
_ask_no_range: Salary-question answer when the posting lists no pay: 'My desired base salary is in the range of $LO to $HI, and I am open to discussing total compensation.'
